meta.name: description
meta.content: Ground of the Giza plateau and the Sphinx enclosure, version 2.1: one seamless sphinx-local height surface made of a 2 m near patch (151 x 121, v2 heights), a 20 m far patch (v2 heights, pyramid bases levelled) and a structured outer ring that runs from the far rim out to 20 km. PBR sand, bedrock strata on the steep walls, baked ambient occlusion. Sphinx-local metres: x east, y up from the enclosure floor (19.95 m ASL), z south. A simulacrum, not a survey.
